source_text: Mosquito collections were conducted in April and May 2018 in Tulukuyi village located in Bungoma County 0.56°N 34.56°E 1427m ASL (Fig. 1). Previous studies conducted by Ochomo, et al. [20] indicated that An. gambiae s.s. was the most predominant species in Bungoma and had high resistance levels to pyrethroids. Sampling was performed by aspiration of blood fed and gravid mosquitoes from 39 houses.
